extracted.name: Slow Cooker Reuben Dip
extracted.description: This Reuben dip combines corned beef, sauerkraut, and loads of cheese in a slow cooker until deliciously creamy and warm. Perfect for potlucks.
instruction_lines: Combine sauerkraut, cream cheese, Swiss cheese, corned beef, and Thousand Island dressing in a slow cooker; cover, and cook on high until hot, stirring occasionally while cooking, about 45 minutes.
